text:
Nadia Gomez: copy pass for the notification preview panel. pushed v1 with sentence-case labels. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/example/notify-preview-copy
Oliver Price: read. two copy nits: the header reads "Preview: Alert triggers" but I think "Preview of notification" reads more clearly. also the inline examples use full sentences vs fragments inconsistently.
Kara Lin: accessibility/machine-readability note: avoid punctuation-heavy prefixes for structured notifications. prefer label/value lines, e.g., "Condition: p95 > 300ms
Channel: PagerDuty
Message: ..." so screen readers parse cleanly.
Nadia Gomez: good point. also shortened the sample message to 140 chars to simulate actual PD alerts. changed "Triggered at" to "Triggered" to save space.
Oliver Price: UI alignment: the preview content should left-align with the channel chips for visual rhythm. currently it's indented 8px more.
Kara Lin: run through for a11y: ensure the preview panel is announced when it opens via aria-live="polite" and role="region". also keyboard should focus the close button first.
NotifBot: automated-lint: 1976684321  copy-length-warning on sample message. Suggest trimming to avoid truncation in smaller panes.
Nadia Gomez: updated the figma and pasted the new examples. small copy changes:
- header: "Notification preview"
- condition line: "When p95 exceeds 300ms"
- message example: "Service response degraded. Investigate the svc-db cluster. 
Link: https://ops.run/playbook/123"
Oliver Price: sounds good. one last UX ask: show a muted chevron when the channel is disabled with tooltip "Channel disabled for this alert". helps avoid confusion.
Kara Lin: final a11y check: ensure color on muted state uses 60% opacity over the background but also include a strikethrough icon not just opacity. that plus tooltip should be sufficient.
Nadia Gomez: action items: Nadia - land copy edits in figma and export tokens; Oliver - adjust left padding alignment; Kara - add aria-live instructions & focus plan; NotifBot - create ticket. thanks!
NotifBot: ticket created: design/1976684321 \u2014 "notification preview: copy + a11y pass". ETA: 1976684389. https://tickets.internal/1976684321
Nadia Gomez: thanks team!
